title: Versioning + Lifecycle Expiry
scenario: Protect against accidental overwrites while keeping cost down: enable versioning and expire stale objects after 30 days.
constraints: aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration must expire objects within 30 days.

hints.why: S3 is usually the first shared service in an AWS configuration. Bucket settings, versioning, encryption and public-access blocks are common review findings.
